title: cyne alternifolia
intro: Cyne alternifolia, commonly known as Sweet Golden Rod or Golden Ragwort, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, skin irritations, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cyne alternifolia include its ability to stimulate digestion, soothe skin conditions, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
